title: Quinn Damerell's original website — April 2012
scope: All same-site links reachable from the requested homepage and recovered pages, including legacy menu targets, and referenced assets. External navigational sites are not crawled. Sources are never executed. Every actual capture date is disclosed; later captures are restorations, not evidence that their bytes existed at the requested date.
static_changes: Preserved exact recovered raw bytes; historical HTML, CSS, JavaScript and SVG sources use inert .txt extensions.
Replaced historical scripts with an audited, local DOM-only gallery and header-tile helper. Original analytics, embeds, event handlers and server forms do not execute.
Restored onclick menu links and section links as ordinary anchors; local navigation stays in the iframe. External navigation opens a separate tab.
Embedded recovered font bytes in served CSS for opaque-origin iframe compatibility.
Unavailable internal pages/downloads have local explanatory notices; unavailable image assets have a visible placeholder. Every failed retrieval remains in the manifest.
